_comment: Register file slug -> the manifest entries it was read from. Read by sources/build_findings.py, sources/build_records.py and by web/lib/files.ts, so the sides cannot drift. `manifest_keys` is not the identity mapping: cbam is ONE register file read from TWO manifest entries, the extension proposal and the consolidated base it amends, which is why a CBAM finding is entitled to say 'mixed'. `declared_status` is only for a file the manifest cannot answer for, and must carry the reason. `display_name` is the act's audience-facing name, the one string a change record is allowed to print for the act; it is the same name web/lib/data.ts FILES holds, and build_records.py checks the two agree rather than letting a rename land on one side only.

omnibus.declared_status_reason: Predates manifest.json — built by build_data.py from the local COM(2025) 81 text, before the fetcher existed. COM(2025) 81, 2025/0045(COD) is a Commission proposal.
omnibus.display_name: Omnibus I — CSRD / CSDDD / Taxonomy simplification

cbam.display_name: CBAM extension — downstream goods and anti-circumvention
